title: Best of Both Torches - Modern
description: (Modern Version) Gives the redstone torch its classic look in item form while keeping its block form the same
body:
Modifies the item model of the redstone torch to give it the same shape as how it was textured before it was changed in 1.21.2 while keeping the block model as its modern version

[Classic Version](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/best-of-both-torches-classic)
